content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-selling-digital-products-africa-stack-2|COREMERCH guide to creator]]s in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-trap-most-creators|The Payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-what-actually-5|automated]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-guide-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway for digital products enables creators to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors that often restrict access. This solution empowers creators by providing them with a secure, low-cost way to monetize their digital offerings. Unlike conventional platforms, which may impose high transaction fees, a crypto payment gateway offers a more favorable fee structure, allowing creators to keep more of their revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway typically involves several key components working together seamlessly. For instance, platforms like NOWPayments integrate with various blockchain networks to ensure secure and instant transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed on-chain, and the product is automatically delivered through tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This streamlined process ensures efficiency and security, all while maintaining full data ownership for the creator.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where access to conventional payment platforms is limited or nonexistent. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this architecture allows you to bypass the limitations imposed by platforms like PayPal and Stripe. By leveraging a crypto payment gateway, you can establish a direct payment channel to your customers, ensuring that your work reaches a wider audience without the hindrance of platform fees.
Reduce your transaction fees from 10% to just 0.5% with a crypto gateway.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of a crypto payment gateway include cloud hosting platforms for file delivery, backend processes for order management, and payment processing solutions. Using services like Cloudflare for hosting and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions, creators can build a robust system that operates independently of traditional payment platforms. Each component plays a vital role in ensuring that the entire process is efficient, secure, and user-friendly.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own crypto payment gateway, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your product listings. Next, integrate a backend solution, such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, to handle order processing. Choose NOWPayments for payment processing, ensuring you have access to a wide range of cryptocurrencies. Finally, configure your product delivery method to automate the transfer of digital goods upon payment confirmation.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a crypto payment gateway. This allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies directly, significantly reducing fees. For instance, while Gumroad takes 10% on each sale, a platform like NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, retaining more of your earnings.
Own your entire digital commerce infrastructure with no dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to build a comprehensive solution for selling digital products without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all necessary blueprints and templates to establish your sovereign digital commerce stack, enabling you to operate independently. Explore the options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I minimize fees when selling digital downloads?

To minimize fees, utilize a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction. This fee structure is far more favorable compared to traditional platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10% on each sale.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my products?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing flexibility to your customers. This wide range ensures that you can cater to diverse payment preferences and market demands.
How do I automate the delivery of my digital products?

You can automate product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools enable you to set up workflows that send files directly to customers upon successful payment confirmation.
Can I set up a store without subscription fees?

Yes, by building your own digital store using a crypto payment gateway, you eliminate subscription fees associated with traditional platforms. You retain full ownership of your revenue and infrastructure.
What’s the best way to start selling templates and fonts?

The best way to start selling templates and fonts is to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using the Complete Builder Kit. This will provide you with all the necessary tools and templates to begin selling quickly and efficiently.
